_doc: Per-car visual audit of the Toyota clean set against the owner's rubric (CLAUDE.md 'Per-car audit rubric'). PASS = ships. Written incrementally: the container is ephemeral and an audit is expensive to redo.

1.name: 2026 Toyota Prius
1.note: wheels absent in 3 of 4 views -- empty arches front and rear; body panels ripple along the flank

4.name: Toyota RAV4 Adventure
4.note: wheel style changes between views: black off-road alloys front34/side, silver alloys rear34; crease artefacts on rear quarter

5.name: Toyota Avensis MK1 T22 1997-2003
5.note: severe -- tyres missing, bare brake discs, one wheel detached and floating under the car, body panels exploded and misaligned

6.name: 2023 Toyota GR Corolla
6.note: proportions read as GR Corolla instantly; strong front 3/4; wheels consistent across all four views; grille has real depth; shut lines defined; reflections clean

7.name: 2023 Toyota GR86
7.note: reads as GR86 instantly; strong front 3/4; identical black multi-spoke wheels in all four views; headlights have internal LED elements; shut lines crisp; clean reflections

9.name: Toyota Auris 2019
9.note: proportions right; grey multi-spoke wheels consistent across views; grille honeycomb has real depth; pillars and wheelbase consistent; premium finish

10.name: Toyota bZ4X
10.note: reads as bZ4X instantly; black cladding correct; wheels identical in all four views; shut lines defined; clean reflections

3.name: Toyota_Supra_GT500_2005
3.note: out of scope, not a quality fault -- Super GT / JGTC race car: full aero wing, slicks, roll cage, no road lighting. No UK reg decodes to this. Geometry itself is sound

13.name: 1998 Toyota Land Cruiser
13.note: reads as J80 Land Cruiser instantly; 6-spoke alloys consistent in all four views; grille lettering crisp; shut lines defined; premium finish. Nit: number plate carries custom text, wants blanking before it ships

8.name: Toyota_gt86
8.note: proportions right but below the premium bar: wheel spokes are soft low-poly blobs with no alloy definition, headlights are dark voids with no internal LED elements, grille shallow. Note this is the first-gen ZN6 GT86, a generation #7 does not cover

11.name: 2016 Toyota Prius
11.note: reads as Gen-4 Prius instantly; 5-spoke alloys consistent across all four views; tail-light internals defined; shut lines crisp; clean reflections

15.name: 2021 Toyota Corolla Cross
15.note: strong -- proportions right, dark multi-spoke wheels identical in all views, grille honeycomb has real depth, headlight internals sharp, premium finish

17.name: Toyota_celica_ssi
17.note: soft 'melt' geometry -- wheels are featureless grey discs with no spokes at all, headlights are blank ovals, panel edges wavy, no shut lines. Exactly the residual miss geom_audit.py documents

18.name: Toyota Celica (Mk3) (A60) liftback 1981
18.note: reads as A60 Celica instantly; 5-spoke wheels consistent; sharp period creases; grille slats crisp; shut lines defined. Nit: plate carries a HUM3D vendor watermark, wants blanking

2.name: Toyota Prius (2020) but unreasonably modded
2.note: joke scene, not a car -- Prius body jacked up on scaffolding with an orange rig, low-poly boulders and stray Mitsubishi parts strewn around. Title says 'unreasonably modded'

16.name: Toyota iQ EV
16.note: reads as iQ instantly; aero-disc alloys consistent across all views; shut lines defined; headlight internals present; clean reflections

20.name: Toyota GR Supra (A90)
20.note: excellent -- reads as A90 Supra instantly; black multi-spoke wheels with red calipers identical in all four views; headlight triple-LED internals sharp; intake mesh has depth; shut lines crisp

21.name: Toyota Supra MK5 A90
21.note: visually identical to #20 in all four views -- same mesh re-exported, 1,820 faces apart (0.21%), under exact-match dedup. Keeping #20

25.name: Toyota Mirai
25.note: reads as 2nd-gen Mirai instantly; turbine alloys consistent in all four views; headlight LED signature sharp; grille mesh has depth; shut lines defined

26.name: toyota corolla 2021 consept
26.note: out of scope -- a fantasy concept supercar wearing a Toyota badge, nothing like a Corolla, and soft/melted geometry besides. Title misspells 'consept', so a 'concept' title gate would not catch it

27.name: Toyota Highlander 2011
27.note: quality passes -- XU40 proportions right, 5-spoke alloys consistent, grille slats crisp, shut lines defined, HUMSTER3D plate watermark wants blanking. SCOPE QUESTION: worth confirming the 2011 Highlander was a UK-market car before indexing; if it was not, no UK reg will ever decode to it

28.name: 2022_Toyota_C-HR_3D_model
28.note: reads as C-HR instantly; two-tone multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views; headlight LED internals sharp; grille mesh has depth; shut lines defined; plate is clean

30.name: Toyota C-HR 2020
30.note: same mesh as #28, 232 faces apart (0.12%), identical in all four views except an 'ItsDiyor' plate watermark. Keeping #28, which has the clean plate

31.name: 2022 Toyota GR86
31.note: quality is strong -- proportions right, black multi-spoke wheels consistent, headlight internals sharp, grille mesh deep, shut lines defined. Redundant with #7 (same GR86 generation, different mesh); catalogue wants one of the two

34.name: Toyota Land Cruiser J100
34.note: UPSIDE DOWN in all four views -- wheels in the air, roof on the floor. Exactly the case geom_audit.py was calibrated to auto-reject, and it reached the clean bucket because that gate is not wired into gpu_wave.py at all

19.name: Toyota Prius 2019
19.note: XW50 facelift Prius; proportions right, grey multi-spoke wheels consistent across views, shut lines defined, headlight internals present. Same generation as #11 -- catalogue wants one

22.name: Toyota Celica ST205 GT4
22.note: reads as ST205 Celica GT-Four instantly; 5-spoke alloys consistent in all four views; projector headlight internals present; grille mesh has depth; correct GT-Four wing; shut lines defined

23.name: Toyota GT86 3D Model (Free)
23.note: the good first-gen ZN6 GT86 -- polished multi-spoke alloys consistent across views, sharp projector internals, grille mesh deep, shut lines crisp. Covers the generation #8 failed on

29.name: Toyota  Prius 2010
29.note: XW30 third-gen Prius -- a generation #11/#19 do not cover. 5-spoke alloys consistent across views, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. HUMSTER3D plate watermark wants blanking

32.name: 2010 Toyota Corolla
32.note: E140 Corolla saloon; proportions right, 5-spoke alloys consistent, grille slats crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined

33.name: Toyota Corolla Sedan Regular 2020
33.note: E210 Corolla saloon; dark multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, headlight LED internals sharp, grille mesh has depth, shut lines crisp, premium finish

35.name: Toyota GT86
35.note: below the premium bar -- 70k faces shows: curves facet visibly, panel edges and mirrors are simplified, headlight internals soft. Redundant anyway, #23 covers the same ZN6 generation at 1.15M faces

36.name: Toyota Highlander 2020
36.note: XU70 Highlander; 5-spoke alloys consistent in all four views, headlight LED internals sharp, grille mesh has depth, shut lines defined. ItsDiyor plate watermark wants blanking

38.name: Toyota RAV4 MK5 2019
38.note: severe -- several duplicate tailgate/body panels left floating detached beside the car, wheels missing in three views, one wheel hanging below the floor. Uploader left every variant in the scene

37.name: Toyota Prius 2020
37.note: quality passes -- black alloys consistent across views, headlight internals sharp, shut lines defined, ItsDiyor plate watermark wants blanking. REDUNDANT: third XW50 Prius after #11 and #19, all one generation

39.name: Toyota Supra A70 Liftback
39.note: reads as A70 Supra instantly; period alloys consistent in all four views; pop-up headlights closed and period-correct; body creases sharp; shut lines defined. Only A70 in the set

40.name: 2024 Toyota Land Cruiser LC300 VXR 409 TT
40.note: excellent -- reads as LC300 instantly, multi-spoke alloys consistent in all four views, grille slat depth crisp, headlight internals sharp, premium reflections, shut lines defined

41.name: Toyota Yaris MK3 2011-2020
41.note: three faults -- wheels missing from all four arches with one wheel detached and floating beneath the car, suspension parts protruding, and the RECOLOUR DID NOT LAND: body renders pink despite the wave forcing --colour silver, with a stray magenta patch on the rear quarter. Header still said 'recolourable'

42.name: 1994 Toyota Camry
42.note: same XV20 mesh as #43, 104 faces apart (0.01%), same wheels and same HUMSTER3D plate. Dropping this one: its title says 1994 on an XV20 body, so #43's title is the one that matches

43.name: Toyota Camry (Mk4)(XV20) 1997
43.note: XV20 Camry; 6-spoke alloys consistent in all four views, panel gaps clean, headlight internals present, reflections clean. Period-simple shapes but no defects. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

44.name: Toyota Avensis (Mk2f)(T250) sedan
44.note: T250 Avensis; 5-spoke alloys consistent in all four views, grille slats crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined, clean reflections. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

45.name: Toyota Avensis (Mk1)(T220) sedan
45.note: T220 Avensis -- a different generation from #44, so it adds coverage rather than repeating it. Wheels consistent, panels intact, shut lines defined. This is the clean T220; #5 was the broken one with exploded panels. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

47.name: Toyota GR Yaris Rocket Bunny Pandem
47.note: out of scope, not a quality fault -- Rocket Bunny / Pandem widebody kit with a huge wing. Well made, but a UK reg decodes to a stock GR Yaris, not a kit car. 'Rocket Bunny' and 'Pandem' are known kit brands a title gate could catch

49.name: toyota supra mk4
49.note: A80 Supra; proportions right, black multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, shut lines defined, clean reflections. Headlight internals are soft -- but the best of the three A80s here

64.name: Toyota Supra Mk4
64.note: below the bar -- headlights entirely absent (smooth body where the lights should be), grille is a plain rectangle, no shut lines, body soft and melted. #49 covers A80 far better

65.name: Toyota Supra
65.note: below the bar -- headlights are plain dark ovals, grille a featureless slot, no shut lines on the doors, body soft. Better than #64 but well under #49, which covers A80

48.name: Toyota Corolla
48.note: E140 Corolla saloon at 1.09M faces; multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille slats crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. Same generation and body as #32 (444k faces) -- this is the higher-resolution of the two

50.name: Toyota Celica (Mk1) (TA22) 1600 GT Coupe 1973
50.note: UPSIDE DOWN in all four views -- the second one in this set after #34. Two in 61 makes the unwired geom_audit orientation gate a systematic leak, not a one-off

51.name: 2020 Toyota Proace Verso City
51.note: Proace City Verso; multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, headlight internals present, shut lines defined, clean reflections. UK-market model. Plate reads MRC 1920 and wants blanking via remove_plates.py

52.name: Toyota Highlander (Mk1)(XU20) 2003
52.note: XU20 Highlander; 5-spoke alloys consistent in all four views, grille slats crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking. SCOPE: same UK-market question as #27 -- and this is now the third Highlander generation in the set

63.name: Toyota MR2 1984-2077
63.note: out of scope -- heavily modified AW11: widebody flares, huge wing, BBS wheels, side-exit exhaust, and the pop-up headlights shaved to a flat panel. Not the stock MR2 a reg decodes to. Title '1984-2077' is a joke

55.name: 2005 Toyota Hilux Double Cab
55.note: Mk6 Hilux double cab; 6-spoke alloys consistent in all four views, grille slats crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined. Strong UK-relevant model. HUMSTER3D plate wants blanking

57.name: 2021 Toyota RAV4 Prime Hybrid E-Four
57.note: excellent -- RAV4 Mk5 reads instantly, black multi-spoke wheels identical in all four views, headlight LED internals sharp, grille mesh deep, premium reflections. Rescues RAV4 coverage after #4 and #38 both failed

53.name: Toyota Camry XV30 2004
53.note: UPSIDE DOWN in all four views -- the THIRD in this set after #34 and #50. Three in 61 is roughly 5% of the clean bucket lost to an orientation gate that exists, is calibrated, and is never called

54.name: 2007 Toyota Camry
54.note: XV40 Camry -- a different generation from #43 (XV20), so it adds coverage. Multi-spoke wheels consistent in all four views, grille slats crisp, headlight internals present, shut lines defined

_to_verify: #30 vs #28 (C-HR, 0.12% apart) and #43 vs #42 (Camry, 0.01% apart) are probable duplicate pairs -- confirm visually when reached
_gate_gap: geom_audit.py is never called by gpu_wave.py -- it is referenced only in render/handler.py, and the handler computes the pose audit only when the submit body sets audit=True, which gpu_wave never does. gpu_wave also discards output['audit']. So the ingest path has NO orientation gate and an upside-down J100 (#34) reached the clean bucket. Wire it.
_recolour_note: #41 proves the sheet header's 'recolourable' (body mats + coverage) does NOT prove a respray works -- it rendered pink under --colour silver. recolour_audit.py --stamp is the only evidence that counts, and gate_catalogue is right to refuse unstamped variants.
